description: This source file defines the MemoryPooledCache class, a generic cache implementation for memory stream provider in Orleans. It manages pooled memory buffers, serialization, and cache eviction strategies for streaming messages.

classes.name: MemoryPooledCache
classes.description: A pooled cache implementation for Orleans memory stream provider supporting serialization, eviction, and cursor operations.

classes.name: Cursor
classes.description: An internal class implementing IQueueCacheCursor for iterating over cached batched messages.

methods.name: QueueMessageToCachedMessage
methods.description: Converts MemoryMessageData to CachedMessage with stream position and packaging into cache segment.

methods.name: SerializeMessageIntoPooledSegment
methods.description: Serializes a MemoryMessageData payload into a pooled buffer segment, allocating a new buffer if necessary.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Creates a StreamPosition object from MemoryMessageData.
